about_the_game:
Corrosion Protocol is a 2D top-down roguelike shooter where each run drops you into a procedurally generated map. Stabilize sub-reactors, survive relentless enemy waves, and adapt your build through an evolving web of weapon and upgrade synergies.

 FEATURES

 Reactive Combat

Blast through hordes of enemies using tight, responsive twin-stick controls. Master dodging, positioning, and precise shooting to stay alive as reactor instability increases.

 Upgrade Synergies

Every run, experiment with new weapons and upgrades that combine into unique builds. Stack explosive modifiers, damage multipliers, elemental effects, and reactor-based perks for devastating results.

 Reactor Stabilization System

Choose when to stabilize or risk meltdown — each reactor decision changes spawn intensity, loot rarity, and environmental hazards. The longer you delay, the greater the chaos (and the rewards).

 Procedural Biomes

Explore dynamically generated zones — from frozen labs and industrial reactors to corrupted forests and desert facilities. No two runs are ever the same.

 Boss Fights

Each sector culminates in a brutal reactor guardian fight designed to test every aspect of your build and reflexes. Adapt or burn.

 Full Controller Support

Play seamlessly with controller or keyboard/mouse. Controls are fully customizable and tuned for both precision and flow.

 Infinite Replayability

Each attempt offers new upgrades, weapons, and biome combinations. Discover powerful synergies, survive longer, and push deeper into the meltdown.

 SUMMARY

Corrosion Protocol combines the intensity of Nuclear Throne with the depth of modern roguelike progression, delivering fast, chaotic, and deeply replayable gameplay focused on moment-to-moment mastery and creative build crafting.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or Apple M1 GPU equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Pro 560X / Apple M1 or better
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound
